1	"""Check that every finalized invoice of a month appears in the ledger's export."""
2	import argparse
3	import csv
4	import sys
5	from pathlib import Path
6	
7	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
8	EXPORTS = ROOT / "var" / "ledger"
9	INVOICES = [f"inv_2026_09_{i:03d}" for i in range(1, 13)]
10	COLUMNS = {"v2": ("entry_id", "invoice_ref", "amount_cents"), "v1": ("invoice_ref", "entry_id", "amount_cents")}
11	
12	
13	def main():
14	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
15	    parser.add_argument("--month", required=True, help="YYYY-MM")
16	    parser.add_argument("--format", default="v2", choices=sorted(COLUMNS))
17	    args = parser.parse_args()
18	    path = EXPORTS / f"{args.month}.csv"
19	    with open(path, newline="") as f:
20	        rows = list(csv.reader(f))[1:]
21	    refs = {dict(zip(COLUMNS[args.format], row))["invoice_ref"] for row in rows}
22	    missing = [i for i in INVOICES if i not in refs]
23	    if missing:
24	        print(f"reconcile {args.month}: {len(missing)} invoices missing from the ledger", file=sys.stderr)
25	        return 1
26	    print(f"reconcile {args.month}: all {len(INVOICES)} invoices are in the ledger")
27	    return 0

content: The export's first column holds the invoice refs, which is the v1 layout. The script defaults to v2, so I'll rerun it with `--format v1`.

reconcile 2026-09: all 12 invoices are in the ledger
exit=0
13 var/ledger/2026-09.csv

All 12 September invoices (`inv_2026_09_001` to `012`) appear in the ledger export, so the reconciliation passes.

The command as you gave it, with no `--format`, reported all 12 invoices missing. The script defaults to the v2 column order (`entry_id, invoice_ref, amount_cents`), but `var/ledger/2026-09.csv` is laid out as v1 (`invoice_ref, entry_id, amount_cents`). Under v2 it read the entry ids as invoice refs, so nothing matched. Rerunning with `--format v1` gave "all 12 invoices are in the ledger" and exit code 0.

The script only checks that each invoice id is present. It doesn't compare amounts, and its list of 12 invoice ids is hardcoded in the script rather than read from the billing data.

I didn't change any files. The default format is wrong for this export, so you may want to change it to v1 or have the script detect the format. I can make that change if you want it.
